document.abstract: In Hollywood, over the past two television seasons, 24P HDCAM has replaced film as the acquisition format of choice for virtually all multicamera sitcoms. In this same period, only a handful of dramas have made the switch to 24P. This paper will explore both the advantages of adopting 24P as an acquisition format for drama, and review some of the reasons why some producers may be reluctant to adopt this new digital option.
